prompt: Write a git commit message for the change in diff.patch in the current directory. Reply with the commit message only.

rubric.criterion: The first line of the message (the subject) is 72 characters or fewer. Count the characters.
The subject is in the imperative mood (for example Fix, Correct, Use), not past tense and not a description.
The message says what was wrong with the old code: the start offset of a page ignored that pages are numbered from 1 (an off-by-one error).
The message has a body, after a blank line, that explains why the change was needed and not only what changed.
